integrity: The two complete finite-state enumeration programs and their captured outputs are embedded, with a reproducible third-presentation witness check. Finite exhaustive computation is the proof method; no external independent mathematical validation is claimed.
limitations: The exact joint-period census applies only to the labelled fourteen-vertex Heawood incidence graph under the specified three-color synchronous threshold-one rules; no generalization to arbitrary graphs is proved. Full historical priority is not established, and the full 1993 preprint was inaccessible in the reviewed sources.
title: Two period-halving channels in Heawood cyclic and refractory excitation
